;Task:
Produce a formatted   12×12   multiplication table of the kind memorized by rote when in primary (or elementary) school.


Only print the top half triangle of products.

INPUT
- The program is ONLY executed as <program> 

OUTPUT:
- Output ONLY the numbers separated with whitespace without row and column numbers

import Text.Printf

main :: IO ()
main = do
    putStrLn "12x12 Multiplication Table"
    forM_ [1..12] $ \row -> do
        forM_ [1..row] $ \col -> do
            printf "%4d" (row * col)
        putStrLn ""
